user.title: Connect to ICS Extranet
user.description: Use the credentials shown on your property-management documents. The group is the value after `groupe=` in your ICS login URL.

data_description.group: For example, use `agency` for a login URL ending in `connexion.php?groupe=agency`.
data_description.update_interval_days: ICS is contacted once every two or three days.
data_description.monthly_payments: Enable this to divide the current quarterly charge call into three monthly payments.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ICS Extranet
reconfigure.description: Change the agency group or polling interval. The group will be validated with ICS before saving.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to ICS Extranet
reauth_confirm.description: Enter valid ICS credentials to resume updates.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect or read the ICS account.
error.invalid_auth: ICS rejected the username or password.
error.already_configured: This ICS account is already configured.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This ICS account is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: ICS Extranet settings were updated successfully.
